sections.description:
Arianne G Esotools is a WordPress plugin that brings five interactive esoteric and spiritual tools to your website. Each tool is available as a simple shortcode that you place on any page or post. No configuration is required — just activate the plugin, paste a shortcode, and the tool appears instantly for your visitors.

The plugin is ideal for astrology sites, numerology blogs, spiritual coaching platforms, tarot or clairvoyance websites, and any wellness-focused project.

How It Works

Each tool is a self-contained interactive widget. Your visitor fills in a short form directly on the page (birth date, full name, or zodiac sign), clicks the Calculate button, and receives an instant result with a detailed interpretation — all calculated locally in their browser, with no page reload and no data sent to any server.

The Five Tools

1. Life Path Number Calculator

The Life Path Number is the most important number in numerology. It is calculated by reducing the visitor’s full birth date (day + month + year) down to a single digit, or one of the master numbers 11, 22, or 33. The result reveals the visitor’s core personality traits and the overall direction of their life. The visitor enters their birth date, clicks Calculate, and instantly sees their Life Path Number alongside a full interpretation.

2. Expression Number Calculator

The Expression Number (also called the Destiny Number) is derived from the visitor’s full name at birth. Each letter is assigned a numerical value (A=1, B=2, C=3 and so on, using the Pythagorean system), and the total is reduced to a single digit or master number. This number describes the natural talents, abilities, and potential that the person is meant to express in their lifetime. The visitor types their full name, clicks Calculate, and receives their Expression Number with a detailed interpretation.

3. Personal Year Calculator

The Personal Year Number reveals the energy and theme of a specific calendar year for an individual. It is calculated by adding the visitor’s birth day and birth month to the current (or any chosen) year, then reducing the total to a single digit. Numbers 1 through 9 each describe a different phase of a nine-year cycle. The visitor enters their birth date and the year they want to explore, clicks Calculate, and receives their Personal Year Number with guidance on what that year means for them.

4. Zodiac Compatibility Checker

This tool calculates the astrological compatibility between two zodiac signs. The visitor selects two signs from dropdown menus and clicks Check Compatibility. The result displays a percentage score, a compatibility level label (from Challenging to Excellent), a color-coded progress bar, and a detailed written analysis of the relationship dynamics between those two signs.

5. Live Moon Phases

This widget displays real-time lunar information calculated automatically from the current date. No input is required from the visitor. The widget shows the current moon phase name (New Moon, Waxing Crescent, First Quarter, etc.), a visual representation of the moon, the current illumination percentage, the date of the next Full Moon, the current Sun sign, and the current Moon sign.

Available Shortcodes

Place any of these shortcodes on a page, post, or widget area to display the corresponding tool:

  • [ariages_life_path] – Life Path Number Calculator
  • [ariages_expression_number] – Expression Number Calculator
  • [ariages_zodiac_compatibility] – Zodiac Compatibility Checker
  • [ariages_personal_year] – Personal Year Calculator
  • [ariages_moon_phases] – Live Moon Phases Display

You can use multiple shortcodes on the same page. Each tool works independently.

Languages

The plugin is fully translated into English and French. It automatically detects your WordPress site language and displays all tool labels, results, and interpretations in the correct language.

  • English (default)
  • French (Français)

Want to help translate into other languages? Visit translate.wordpress.org

Privacy & GDPR

This plugin does not collect, store, or transmit any personal data. All calculations are performed locally in the visitor’s browser using JavaScript. No information entered by visitors (names, birth dates, zodiac signs) is ever sent to any server or third party. The plugin is fully GDPR compliant.

Credits

  • Plugin developed by Arianne Galfre – Arianne G Voyance Publications
  • Icons from WordPress Dashicons
  • Numerology interpretations based on traditional numerology systems
  • Astrological data based on standard Western astrology

Support

For support, please visit the plugin support forum or contact us at wpwebtools@arianne-g-voyance.fr

Contribute

Help translate this plugin into your language!
Visit translate.wordpress.org
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation (recommended)

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel.
  2. Go to Plugins -> Add New.
  3. Search for Arianne G Esotools.
  4. Click Install Now, then click Activate.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin panel.
  3. Go to Plugins -> Add New -> Upload Plugin.
  4. Choose the ZIP file and click Install Now.
  5. Click Activate Plugin.

After Activation

Once the plugin is activated, no configuration is needed. To add a tool to a page:

  1. Go to AG Esotools in your WordPress admin left-hand menu.
  2. Click the Shortcodes tab.
  3. Click the COPY button next to the tool you want to use.
  4. Open any page or post in the editor.
  5. Paste the shortcode into the content area.
  6. Save and preview the page.

The tool will appear immediately, fully styled and ready to use.

Using with Page Builders

Gutenberg (Block Editor):
1. Open a page or post.
2. Add a Shortcode block (search for “Shortcode” in the block inserter).
3. Paste the shortcode into the block.
4. Click Preview to see the tool, then Publish or Update.

Elementor:
1. Open a page with Elementor.
2. Search for the Shortcode widget in the Elementor panel and drag it onto the page.
3. Paste the shortcode into the widget’s Shortcode field.
4. Click Update to save.

Divi:
1. Open a page with Divi Builder.
2. Add a Code module to your layout.
3. Paste the shortcode into the code area.
4. Click Save to apply.

Language Configuration

The plugin uses your WordPress site language automatically. To change the language:

  1. Go to Settings -> General in your WordPress admin panel.
  2. Find the Site Language dropdown.
  3. Select your preferred language (English or French).
  4. Click Save Changes.

The plugin will immediately switch to the selected language. No additional setup is required.
sections.faq:
How do I add a tool to my page?

Go to AG Esotools -> Shortcodes in your WordPress admin, click COPY next to the tool you want, then paste the shortcode into any page, post, or widget area. The tool appears automatically on the front end.

How does the Life Path Number Calculator work?

The visitor enters their birth date using the date picker and clicks Calculate. The plugin adds together all the digits of the day, month, and year, reducing the total to a single digit or master number (11, 22, or 33). The result is displayed immediately with a full written interpretation of what that number means for the visitor’s personality and life path.

How does the Expression Number Calculator work?

The visitor types their full birth name into the text field and clicks Calculate. The plugin assigns a number from 1 to 9 to each letter using the standard Pythagorean numerology table, sums all the values, and reduces the total to a single digit or master number. The result includes a complete interpretation of the visitor’s natural talents and destiny.

How does the Personal Year Calculator work?

The visitor enters their birth date and selects a year (the current year is pre-filled automatically), then clicks Calculate. The plugin adds the birth day and birth month to the chosen year and reduces the total to a number from 1 to 9. Each number represents a different theme or life energy for that year, displayed with a detailed interpretation and practical guidance.

How does the Zodiac Compatibility Checker work?

The visitor selects two zodiac signs from the dropdown menus and clicks Check Compatibility. The plugin looks up the compatibility profile for that pair of signs and displays a percentage score, a level label (Challenging, Moderate, Good, Very Good, or Excellent), a color-coded progress bar, and a written analysis describing the relationship dynamics between the two signs.

How does the Moon Phases widget work?

The Moon Phases widget requires no input from the visitor. When the page loads, it automatically calculates the current lunar phase based on today’s date. It displays the phase name, a visual illustration of the moon’s current appearance, the illumination percentage, the date of the next Full Moon, the current Sun sign, and the current Moon sign.

Does the plugin connect to an external API or service?

No. All calculations are performed entirely within the visitor’s browser using JavaScript. No external API calls or server requests are made at any point.

Does this plugin collect or store visitor data?

No. The plugin does not collect, store, or transmit any personal information. Inputs entered by visitors (names, birth dates, zodiac sign selections) are used only for the on-screen calculation and are never saved or sent anywhere.

Can I display multiple tools on the same page?

Yes. You can place as many shortcodes as you want on the same page. Each tool operates independently and they will not interfere with each other.

Can I customize the appearance of the tools?

Yes. You can add custom CSS to your theme to override the default styles. All elements use CSS classes prefixed with ariages-, for example: .ariages-widget, .ariages-btn, .ariages-result, .ariages-moon-widget. You can target any of these classes in your theme’s Additional CSS (Appearance -> Customize -> Additional CSS).

How do I change the language of the plugin?

Go to Settings -> General in your WordPress admin and change the Site Language setting. The plugin supports English and French and switches automatically — no additional steps are needed.

Is the plugin compatible with my theme?

Yes. The plugin is designed to work with any properly coded WordPress theme. Its widgets use their own scoped CSS classes and do not interfere with theme styles.

Is this plugin compatible with WordPress multisite?

The plugin has not been specifically tested on multisite installations. It is designed for standard single-site WordPress setups.
sections.changelog:
1.0.6 – 2026-02-15

  • Fixed: Removed .htaccess from languages/ (hidden files not permitted by WordPress.org)
  • Fixed: Removed .l10n.php files (auto-generated by WordPress 6.5+, should not be distributed)
  • Fixed: Removed backup .po~ files from plugin distribution
  • Cleanup: Languages directory now contains only essential files (.po, .mo, .pot, index.php)
  • WordPress.org: Plugin now passes all Plugin Check validations with 0 errors

1.0.5 – 2026-02-05

  • WordPress.org Compliance: Removed deprecated load_plugin_textdomain() function (discouraged since WP 4.6)
  • Security: Added whitelist validation for admin tab parameter
  • Code Quality: Improved translation loading for automatic WordPress.org integration
  • Code Quality: Enhanced admin panel input validation
  • Plugin Check: Resolved all severity 6-8 errors and severity 5 warnings

1.0.4 – 2026-01-20

  • Security: Replaced all _e() calls with esc_html_e() for proper output escaping
  • Security: Added wp_unslash() for $_GET parameter sanitization
  • Security: Fixed printf() output escaping with wp_kses_post() and esc_html()
  • Security: Replaced date() with gmdate() to avoid timezone issues
  • Code Quality: Improved WordPress coding standards compliance
  • Plugin Repository: Updated “Tested up to” version to WordPress 6.9
  • Plugin Repository: Reduced tags count to comply with 5-tag limit

1.0.0 – 2025-01-15

  • Initial release
  • Life Path Number Calculator
  • Expression Number Calculator
  • Zodiac Compatibility Checker
  • Personal Year Calculator
  • Live Moon Phases Display
  • English and French translations
  • Responsive design
  • GDPR compliance
